approved: Defence Capability Assurance and Oversight Bill 2024
Written by a model from the explanatory memorandum; not the record
The bill creates a new independent body to assess risks in buying and maintaining military equipment.
This body, the Defence Capability Assurance Agency, would oversee testing and evaluation to give decision-makers reliable information.
The bill also plans a long-term deal with an Australian industry partner to support these activities.
Establishes the Defence Capability Assurance Agency as an independent statutory body.
Requires Defence to use the agency for risk evaluation across the capability life cycle.
Creates the Defence Capability Assurance Regulator to set qualifications and standards for testing and evaluation staff.
Provides for a long-term agreement with an Australian industry partner to supply expertise and a centre of excellence.
Defence, its capability managers, the Government, and the Australian industry partner.

The speaker moved the Defence Capability Assurance and Oversight Bill 2023 to establish the Defence Capability Assurance Agency, an Inspector-General of Defence Capability Assurance, and a Parliamentary Joint Committee on Defence; the bill was agreed to and read a first time.
